about_the_game:
Ollsgar’d is a bold reimagining of the classic marbles game—now reimagined into a fast-paced, challenging, and totally unique experience! With innovative mechanics, fast-paced gameplay, and voice control, you can play however you want! Whether you’re shouting, clapping, using your dog, playing instruments, or anything in between, you’ll have a hilarious and highly entertaining experience.

What is Ollsgar'd?

Ollsgar'd is nothing more than a marbles game where you battle using voice control.

  • It features two modes: Incremental and Marble Battle.

  • 999 rounds of pure challenge.

  • Collect tons of lemon tarts.

  • Challenge yourself by playing Ollsgar'd not only with your voice, but also with instruments, clapping, and other things your creativity allows.
